purpose: Teach: 暁/攻勢/駆動/気質/旋律/文化庁/回帰/押しつけ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新事業、成功の暁には、社員に、賞与、出す予定だ。
lines.en: When this new venture succeeds, I intend to give the staff a substantial bonus.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Slight pause before 'staff' — the promise lands clearly. Even tone throughout, almost formal in its precision. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合の攻勢、当社、戦略で、応戦しています。
lines.en: Understood. We're actively countering the competitors' moves with our own strategy.
lines.style: Professional, steady. Meets the statement head-on without overexplaining. Voice sits at eye-contact level. Competent without seeking approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、電気駆動方式、業界の主流に、なりつつある。
lines.en: Electric-drive technology is becoming the industry standard. Our new product is well-positioned.
lines.style: Declarative and clear. Brief pause after the first clause — letting it register. Slight lift at the end, not a question but an observation of fact. Voice remains controlled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の気質に合わせた、配属、人事課が、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. HR is moving forward with assignments that match each employee's strengths and temperament.
lines.style: Straightforward update. No inflation in the delivery — just the information, accurately conveyed. Slight emphasis on 'matches,' then trails to neutral closure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: CM音楽の旋律、印象に残るよう、新作、こだわって、作れ。
lines.en: The music for our new commercial — make sure the melody is memorable and distinctive. No compromise on that.
lines.style: Shifts to instruction mode. Firmer attack on 'memorable.' Slight weight on 'distinctive' — this matters. Not harsh, but non-negotiable. Lean forward slightly in posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。文化庁の助成事業、企業として、参加検討しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently exploring participation in the Cultural Affairs Ministry's subsidy program as a company.
lines.style: Factual, methodical. Emphasis on 'currently exploring' — suggests deliberation, not hesitation. Steady pace. Professional closure with slight upward lilt on 'program.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業精神への回帰、来期方針として、明確化しろ。
lines.en: Next term, we need to make our return to founding principles our explicit policy direction. Clarify that across the board.
lines.style: Instructional but not cold. Weight on 'explicit' — this should be unmistakable to everyone. Moderate pace. Slight lean-in on 'across the board,' ensuring buy-in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。責任を、社員に、押しつけない経営、心がけてまいります。
lines.en: Understood. We'll be mindful to lead without placing undue burden on the staff. That's our commitment going forward.
lines.style: Solemn and sincere beneath the formality. Slight pause before 'undue burden' — respect for the weight of that phrase. Quiet conviction at the close. Not eager, but earnest.
